content: विषम {%a.%} [विगतो विरुद्धो वा समः] .²1 Uneven, rough, rugged; पथिषु विषमेष्वप्यचलता <ls>Mu. 3. 3</ls>; व्यालकीर्णाः सुविषमाः <ls>Pt. 1. 64</ls>; <ls>Me. 19</ls>. .²2 Irregular, unequal; तोषं ततान विषमग्रथितोऽपि भागः <ls>Māl. 9. 44</ls>. .²3 Odd, not even. .²4 Difficult, hard to understand, mysterious; विषमोऽपि विगाह्यते नयः <ls>Ki. 2. 3</ls>; विषमाः कर्मगतयः <ls>Pt. 4. 50</ls>. .²5 Impassable, inaccessible; <ls>Ki. 2. 3</ls>; भ्रान्तं देशमनेकदुर्गविषमम् <ls>Bh. 3. 5</ls>. .²6 Coarse, rough. .²7 Oblique; ईषत्तिर्यग्वलनविषमम् <ls>Māl. 4. 2</ls>. .²8 Painful, troublesome; कान्ताविश्लेषदुःखव्यतिकरविषमे यौवने विप्रयोगः <ls>Bh. 3. 106</ls>; <ls>H. 4. 3</ls>. .²9 Very strong, vehement; व्यनक्त्यन्तस्तापं तदयमतिधीरोऽपि विषमम् <ls>Māl. 3. 9</ls>. .²10 Dangerous, fearful; सर्वकषः कषति हा विषमः कृतान्तः <ls>Mv. 5. 56</ls>; <ls>Mk. 8. 1</ls>, <ls n="Mk. 8.">27</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 18</ls>, <ls n="Mu.">2. 20</ls>. .²11 Bad, adverse, unfavourable; येन च हसितं दशासु विषमासु <ls>Pt. 4. 16</ls>. .²12 Odd, unusual, unparalleled. .²13 Dishonest, artful. .²14 Intermittent (as fever). .²15 Wicked. .²16 Different. .²17 That which cannot be equally divided; अजाविकं सैकशफं न जातु विषमं भजेत् <ls>Ms. 9. 119</ls>. .²18 Unsuitable, wrong; <ls>Suśr.</ls> .{@-मः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²2 (In music) A kind of measure. .{@-मम्@} .²1 Unevenness. .²2 Oddness. .²3 An inaccessible place, precipice, pit <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 A difficult or dangerous position, difficulty, misfortune; सुप्तं प्रमत्तं विषमस्थितं वा रक्षन्ति पुण्यानि पुरा कृतानि <ls>Bh. 2. 97</ls>; कुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम् <ls>Bg. 2. 2</ls>. .²5 Rough or uneven ground. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a figure of speech in which some unusual or incompatible relation between cause and effect is described; (said to be of four kinds; see <ls>K. P.</ls> Kārikās 126 and 127). .²7 A kind of stanza or verse; भिन्नचिह्नचतुष्पादं विषमं परिकीर्तितम्. .{@-मम्@} {%ind.%} Unequally, unevenly, unfairly, dangerously <ab>&c.</ab>
